original: En cuanto a su historia, la Isla San Rafael ha sido objeto de escasas exploraciones científicas, y su uso por parte de la humanidad ha sido limitado. Se registran pocas referencias históricas, y su descubrimiento se atribuye a navegantes argentinos del siglo XIX, aunque no hay registros precisos. Desde entonces, ha sido objeto de estudios biológicos y ambientales, especialmente por instituciones científicas argentinas que buscan comprender el impacto del cambio climático en ecosistemas aislados.
rewrite: Regarding its past, San Rafael Island has undergone limited scientific investigations, and human engagement with it has remained minimal. Historical mentions are rare, and its discovery is credited to Argentine sailors from the 19th century, though exact records are absent. Since then, it has been the focus of biological and environmental research, particularly by Argentine scientific organizations aiming to grasp the effects of climate change on isolated ecosystems.
